name: GHK-Cu 100 mg
shortDescription: GHK-Cu, the copper-binding tripeptide, supplied at a high 100 mg load for regenerative and skin research. For research purposes only.
description:

This high-concentration 100 mg presentation is intended for extended or higher-dose research protocols.

Commonly explored in research for:

  • Collagen, elastin and glycosaminoglycan synthesis in skin-remodelling models
  • Wound-healing, dermal-repair and tissue-regeneration pathways
  • Antioxidant, metal-chelation and anti-inflammatory signalling
  • Hair-follicle research and gene-expression modulation

Supplied as 100 mg lyophilized powder for reconstitution; also available loaded in the Lyfe pen.
